items.title: 验证 Layer 1 Development Baseline 正式 proof 状态
items.context: 运行六个 Development baseline 的 local/off 审计与 suite report，区分 runner 已存在和 formal PASS 是否成立；缺 independent review evidence 时必须记录 BLOCKED/未授权，不得宣称 Layer 1 formal pass。
items.userSees: User sees "Layer 1 formalProofStatus" with PASS/BLOCKED, exact missingEvidence, and the resulting Baseline 2-5 startDecision in the B-688d final report.

happy.desc: Run baseline_run on the local/off baseline set and show the command succeeds while explicitly labeling runner support versus independent proof.
Generate baseline_suite_report from the same material hash and confirm it reports the formal proof status separately from raw runner availability.

edge.desc: A baseline suite may execute successfully even when independent review evidence is absent; the report must still classify the result as blocked or not-authorized instead of PASS.
If evidence is stale, local-only, or from a shadow runner, the report must preserve the missing or insufficient-proof reason instead of collapsing it into a formal pass.

adversarial.desc: Reject any false Layer 1 PASS that is inferred from runner support alone when no independent proof exists.
Reject any report text that upgrades local/off evidence into a production-formal proof claim.

verificationEvidence.note: Six Development baseline runs were executed in non-authority mode; runner support is evidenced, while formal proof remains blocked because independent local review evidence is missing.
Suite aggregation exists and reports suiteStatus=FAIL separately from runner availability; minimumSuite is present but formal proof is not satisfied.
The suite preserves blockedReason=local independent review evidence is missing for 5 expected-PASS runs instead of converting command execution into PASS.
Final report records GO-NOT-YET, runnerSourceLocatable=false, authorityMode=off, and evidenceClass=local-lifecycle, preserving insufficient-proof reasons.
False Layer 1 PASS is rejected: final decision is GO-NOT-YET and blockedReasons name missing independent review evidence.
Local/off evidence is not upgraded to production proof: receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityChanged are false and receiptRefs is empty.

items.title: 冻结 Baseline 2-5 并行开发共享契约
items.context: 产出 shared-contract/ownership/merge-queue/claim-lock 的执行 artifact，固定 runId、materialHash、evidenceRef、final-report、baseline-suite-report、claim-report、authorityMode/evidenceClass 字段；禁止 workstream 自定义 schema。
items.userSees: User sees "sharedContractVersion: baseline-parallel-v1" plus frozen authorityMode/evidenceClass/final-report/merge-queue/claim-lock schemas in .omx/artifacts/parallel-development/B-688d/.

happy.desc: Verify the shared-contract, ownership-map, merge-queue, and claim-lock artifacts all freeze the same runId, materialHash, evidenceRef, and report field set.
Confirm authorityMode and evidenceClass remain consistent across every frozen artifact and that no workstream adds custom schema fields.

edge.desc: A partial artifact update must be detected if any frozen field diverges or any non-authority projection omits a required field.
The contract must tolerate read-only projections without granting authority, while still preserving the canonical field names and values.

adversarial.desc: Reject any local evidence that claims production authority or receipt-backed authority without the canonical authority fields proving it.
Reject any attempt to smuggle workstream-specific schema into the frozen shared contract by renaming or expanding authority-related fields.

verificationEvidence.note: Shared contract, ownership map, merge queue, claim lock, and final report use a single B-688d artifact set with canonical authority/report fields.
Authority boundary is consistent: authorityMode=off, evidenceClass=local-lifecycle, and nested authority fields remain false/empty.
Partial or inconsistent unlock is prevented by 4 explicit locks covering Engineering, Loop, Production Safety, and Capability Claim unlock.
Read-only/non-authority projections are allowed only as local-lifecycle artifacts and do not grant production authority.
Receipt-backed or production authority claims are blocked: all authority flags are false and receiptRefs is empty.

verificationEvidence.command: jq '[.lanes[] | select((has("ownedPaths")|not) or (has("readOnlyPaths")|not) or (has("mode")|not) or (has("allowedOutputs")|not) or (has("stopConditions")|not) or (has("sequentialProofLock")|not))] | length' .omx/artifacts/parallel-development/B-688d/dispatch-audit.json
verificationEvidence.note: No lane uses custom or missing schema fields; required dispatch fields are present for all 8 lanes.

items.title: 生成 2 host / 8 agent 并行 dispatch 审计包
items.context: 为 Codex CLI 与 Claude CLI 两个 host 生成四个 implementer 和四个 opposite-host reviewer 的 dispatch 包；每条线必须包含 ownedPaths、readOnlyPaths、mode、allowed outputs、stop conditions 和 sequential proof lock。
items.userSees: User sees "dispatchDecision" with GO/GO-NOT-YET/BLOCKED plus exact Codex CLI and Claude CLI lane assignments, ownedPaths/readOnlyPaths, stop conditions, and sequentialProofLock.

happy.desc: Produce a 2-host/8-agent dispatch audit with four Codex CLI lanes and four Claude CLI lanes, including implementer and opposite-host reviewer roles.
Show host-neutral boundaries via ownedPaths, readOnlyPaths, mode, allowed outputs, stop conditions, and sequential proof lock for every lane.

edge.desc: If one host is degraded or unavailable, the dispatch package must preserve the same boundaries and stop conditions instead of rebalancing ownership or optimizing for speed.
The audit should remain valid even when a lane is read-only only; it must not convert a reviewer lane into an implementer lane.

adversarial.desc: Block any dispatch package that launches work before the required proof exists or before the sequential proof lock is satisfied.
Reject arbitrary optimization, lane collapsing, or scope expansion that tries to make the package look more productive than the proof actually supports.

verificationEvidence.note: Dispatch audit contains exactly 2 host categories and 8 lanes split across implementer and opposite-host reviewer roles.

verificationEvidence.command: jq '[.lanes[] | {laneId, ownedPaths, readOnlyPaths, mode, allowedOutputs, stopConditions, sequentialProofLock}]' .omx/artifacts/parallel-development/B-688d/dispatch-audit.json
verificationEvidence.note: Every lane declares ownedPaths, readOnlyPaths, mode, allowedOutputs, stopConditions, and sequentialProofLock.
Host probes record Codex CLI and Claude CLI availability; dispatch still remains GO-NOT-YET because proof, not host availability, is the blocker.
Reviewer lanes remain audit_only or not_authorized and are not converted into implementer lanes.
All implementer lanes are not_authorized while GO-NOT-YET is active, so dispatch does not launch work before proof exists.
The package rejects arbitrary optimization/lane activation: decision is GO-NOT-YET and 4 locks remain active.
